principles.source_policy: free_public_only for extended company news and earnings fulfillment
principles.display_carry_forward: allowed only after the first observed sentiment and is not a new observation
principles.sp500_sentiment: renormalized cap-weighted mean across observed constituents only
principles.sp500_price: true index source such as ^GSPC, never SPY as index-level substitute
principles.universe_boundary: Composite 1500 company coverage is separate from S&P 500 index weighting, attribution, portfolio and research contracts
principles.transcript_policy: structured call analytics require actual free-public transcript text; transcript body text is not redistributed

resources.description: S&P 500 + MidCap 400 + SmallCap 600 company metadata and latest market fields
Retained deduplicated free-public company news with article sentiment where scored
Extended-company daily price history plus observed-only daily sentiment and observation flags
resources.missing_semantics: A false sentiment_observed flag means there was no scored sentiment observation on that date.

resources.description: EPS history, derived structured-call diagnostics when available, call source links and supporting SEC/IR material
News, price-history and fulfillment coverage across the Composite company universe
Complete, partial, link-only and missing free-public structured-call status by company
Clustered company/theme event instances derived from retained article evidence
S&P 500 true-index daily close, observed-only aggregate sentiment and coverage
Core constituent metadata, index weight, price reaction and latest observed sentiment
Core symbols with legacy full ticker snapshots
Core price/sentiment history plus scored article evidence
resources.missing_semantics: Use sentiment_observed / n_total when present. Carried-forward display S is not a new observation.

natural_language_interface.behavior: Natural language maps to explicit filters and rankings over published fields.

research_lab.inference: Newey-West/Bartlett HAC for mean daily high-minus-low spread; lag = horizon - 1
research_lab.specification_id: stable hash of selected research specification
